// Contrato em task.md. Motor puro: sem three, react, motion nem DOM.
import type { Vec2 } from './vec.ts'
import type { Vitals } from './stats.ts'
import type { Room, RoomId } from './arena.ts'

export type EnemyKind = 'hollow' | 'boss'
export type EnemyState = 'idle' | 'intro' | 'chase' | 'windup' | 'attack' | 'recover' | 'stagger' | 'dead'
export type EnemyAttackName = 'slash' | 'slam' | 'charge' | 'shockwave'
export type EnemyAttackShape = 'arc' | 'radius' | 'charge'

export type Enemy = {
  id: number
  kind: EnemyKind
  room: RoomId
  home: Vec2
  homeYaw: number
  pos: Vec2
  yaw: number
  vitals: Vitals
  state: EnemyState
  t: number
  attack: EnemyAttackName | null
  hitDone: boolean
  phase: 1 | 2
}

export type EnemyHit = { damage: number; poiseDamage: number; origin: Vec2 }
export type EnemyTarget = { pos: Vec2; alive: boolean }

export type EnemyProfile = {
  hp: number
  poise: number
  radius: number
  speed: number
  aggroRange: number
  staggerTime: number
  runes: number
  intro: number
}

export type EnemyAttack = {
  windup: number
  active: number
  recover: number
  damage: number
  poiseDamage: number
  range: number
  arcDeg: number
  shape: EnemyAttackShape
  startRange: number
}

export const ENEMY_PROFILES: Record<EnemyKind, EnemyProfile> = {
  hollow: { hp: 120, poise: 30, radius: 0.45, speed: 3, aggroRange: 9, staggerTime: 1.5, runes: 100, intro: 0 },
  boss: { hp: 1500, poise: 80, radius: 1.0, speed: 3.5, aggroRange: 40, staggerTime: 2.0, runes: 5000, intro: 2.0 },
}

export const ENEMY_ATTACKS: Record<EnemyKind, Partial<Record<EnemyAttackName, EnemyAttack>>> = {
  hollow: {
    slash: { windup: 0.5, active: 0.3, recover: 0.8, damage: 60, poiseDamage: 20, range: 1.8, arcDeg: 100, shape: 'arc', startRange: 2.0 },
  },
  boss: {
    slash: { windup: 0.6, active: 0.3, recover: 0.9, damage: 110, poiseDamage: 25, range: 2.8, arcDeg: 120, shape: 'arc', startRange: 4.0 },
    slam: { windup: 1.0, active: 0.3, recover: 1.2, damage: 160, poiseDamage: 40, range: 3.0, arcDeg: 360, shape: 'radius', startRange: 4.0 },
    charge: { windup: 0.4, active: 0.7, recover: 1.0, damage: 90, poiseDamage: 20, range: 1.4, arcDeg: 0, shape: 'charge', startRange: Infinity },
    shockwave: { windup: 0.8, active: 0.2, recover: 1.5, damage: 120, poiseDamage: 30, range: 5.0, arcDeg: 360, shape: 'radius', startRange: Infinity },
  },
}

export const CHARGE_SPEED = 12
export const TRACK_RATE = 2.5
export const BOSS_PHASE2_HP = 750
export const PHASE2_SPEED = 4.5
export const PHASE2_WINDUP = 0.75
export const CHARGE_DISTANCE = 5
export const RIPOSTE_RECOVER = 1.0

export function createEnemy(id: number, kind: EnemyKind, room: RoomId, pos: Vec2, yaw: number): Enemy {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: createEnemy(${id},${kind},${room},${pos.x},${yaw})`)
}

export function respawnEnemy(enemy: Enemy): Enemy {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: respawnEnemy(${enemy.id})`)
}

export function enemyRadius(enemy: Enemy): number {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: enemyRadius(${enemy.id})`)
}

export function stepEnemy(enemy: Enemy, target: EnemyTarget, dt: number, rng: number, room: Room): { enemy: Enemy; rng: number; hit: EnemyHit | null } {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: stepEnemy(${enemy.id},${target.alive},${dt},${rng},${room.id})`)
}
